integrity: Analytic proof for all permitted graph orders and real multipliers. Rational finite graph checks plus independent numerical linear programs corroborate, but do not replace, the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple unit-edge diameter-two girth-five Moore graphs, real Lipschitz space, real adjacency spectral filters.
Existence of a degree-57 Moore graph is not assumed or proved.

The nonnegative heat branch and initial curvature can be independently obtained from earlier positive Markov-chain curvature formulas; the primary new claim is the unrestricted signed three-phase classification.
No independent mathematical or historical originality audit has been performed.
title: Exact Lipschitz norm and three-phase geometry of Moore-graph spectral filters
